title: The Last Customer
continuity: Every shot stays in the same petrol station forecourt and the same shop interior; never cut to a new location
The Hollow Man only changes position while the fluorescent lights flicker; between flickers he holds the same pose and is closer
Mara never leaves the shop until shot 6, and never turns her back on the window
The red staff tabard is the only saturated colour in the film
Each shot starts on the action that ended the previous shot; hard cuts only

shots.desc: Wide establishing shot of the empty forecourt at 3 AM. Fog drifts between the pumps. Mara sits behind the counter reading, lit by one buzzing fluorescent tube; the red sign flickers above her.
shots.sketch: Wide shot of the isolated petrol station, two pumps, fog, one small figure behind the shop counter, red sign above
shots.caption: 3:07 AM. No cars for an hour.
shots.sfx: fluorescent buzz, distant wind, a slow low drone

shots.desc: The door chime rings. Mara looks up. Through the fogged glass, an impossibly tall silhouette stands at the edge of the pump light, facing away from her.
shots.sketch: Mara looking up from the counter, the tall silhouette outside at the edge of the light, facing away, fogged glass between them
shots.caption: Then the door chimed.
shots.sfx: single door chime, drone swells, no footsteps

shots.desc: Mara leans toward the window. The forecourt is empty. One wet bare footprint sits on the concrete just outside the door, pointing in.
shots.sketch: Close-up of Mara peering through the glass, empty forecourt beyond, one wet footprint on the concrete pointing toward the door
shots.caption: But nobody came in.
shots.sfx: held breath, a faint wet step

shots.desc: The fluorescent tube stutters. In the half-second of dark the silhouette is suddenly at the window, face level with the glass, smooth and featureless. The light steadies; he does not move.
shots.sketch: The featureless tall figure pressed close to the shop window, Mara small behind the counter, one light flickering
shots.caption: Don't look at it.
shots.sfx: electrical crackle, a hard music sting, then near silence

shots.desc: Mara drops below the counter and grabs the phone. The dial tone is dead. Above her, the window glass fogs from the outside, as if something is breathing on it.
shots.sketch: Mara crouched below the counter with the phone, the window above fogging from outside, no reflection
shots.caption: The line was dead.
shots.sfx: dead line click, low breathing, glass creak

shots.desc: She crawls through the stockroom door and freezes. The Hollow Man is already inside, standing at the far end of the aisle in complete darkness, head tilted, arms too long.
shots.sketch: Mara on the floor of the stockroom, the tall figure standing at the end of the dark aisle, shelving between them
shots.caption: It was already inside.
shots.sfx: drone drops, a single shelf rattle, no breathing

shots.desc: Mara backs into the walk-in fridge and pulls the heavy door shut. Through the small window, a long shadow passes under the door and stops.
shots.sketch: Mara inside the walk-in fridge, hands on the door, a long shadow under the door outside, cold blue light
shots.caption: Hold your breath.
shots.sfx: door seal hiss, compressor hum, a wet drag outside

shots.desc: Her phone lights up: 3:07 AM. The fridge light flickers. In the dark the Hollow Man is crouched inches from her face. The light catches his blank skin.
shots.sketch: Extreme close-up of the featureless face crouched inches from Mara, phone light between them, fridge shelves behind
shots.caption: It only moves in the dark.
shots.sfx: phone buzz, light flicker, a dry inhale

shots.desc: The lights go out. Two seconds of black. They snap back on: the shop is empty, the till drawer open, the door swinging. On the counter sits a single wet handprint. The red sign flickers once and dies.
shots.sketch: Empty shop after the attack, open till, swinging door, one wet handprint on the counter, red sign dead
shots.caption: Mara was never found.
shots.sfx: total silence, one electrical pop, drone cuts out

log.goal: survive a night shift when a customer who is not a customer arrives
log.scare: the figure only moves during the light flickers, and is always closer
log.ending: the station is empty except for a wet handprint; Mara is gone
